neighbours.label: A trailing ellipsis or emoticon that closes an informal line or a status string ('Terminating...', 'doing that :3', 'go down earlier…', 'images :D'), firing on the '...', '…' or ' :'; the same lines closed with a period stay quiet.
fire: I can't believe it's Monday again...
well, that didn't go as planned…
Thanks for the birthday wishes everyone :D
Guess who forgot their keys again :P
quiet: I can't believe it's Monday again.
Well, that didn't go as planned.
Thanks for the birthday wishes, everyone.
Guess who forgot their keys again.

predictions: fire 0.1-0.7; near misses below 0.05; ':D' may be weak
notes: Card: peaks on ' :' x10, '…' x8, '...' x7, '!' x6 at the end of informal lines and log strings; auto test held (AUROC 0.91) for '...' inside a quotation or string. Output promotes '\r\n'. Exploratory probe: 'Terminating...' 0.69, ':3' 0.71, '…' 0.32, ':D' 0.13; period versions 0.001-0.02.
